entries.name: Afeni Shakur

expected.charges: Conspiracy to bomb New York City police stations, a railroad station, and Manhattan department stores (Panther 21 prosecution)
expected.sentence:
Held without bail approximately 11 months at the Womens House of Detention; bonded out February 1971; acquitted with the entire Panther 21 by New York jury on May 13, 1971 after deliberation of less than 45 minutes

Verdict as recorded: No — acquitted on all 156 counts

updates.sentence: Initial Panther 21 pretrial detention ended with release on bail January 30, 1970. Later remand beginning February 8, 1971 was a separate custody period. Acquitted May 13, 1971.

entries.rationale: Remove false continuous detention through May 1971; January 30 bail supported by two histories. Court dates later remand February 8, not February 3 in some secondary sources. Separate remand case follows.

entries.name: Curtis Powell

expected.charges: New York state conspiracy (156 counts) - Panther 21 indictment of April 2, 1969.
expected.sentence:
~2 years pretrial detention; acquitted by jury verdict, May 13, 1971.

Verdict as recorded: No - acquitted by jury, New York Supreme Court, May 13, 1971

Charges as recorded: New York state conspiracy (156 counts) - Panther 21 indictment of April 2, 1969 for alleged plot to bomb NYPD precincts, the Bronx Botanical Garden, midtown department stores, and a railroad right-of-way.

entries.rationale: NYPL personal papers finding aid dates arrest April 2 and continued detention until May 1971 acquittal. May 12 endpoint predates May 13 verdict; use verified release month pending direct exact-day discharge evidence.
